notes: Riot announces errata as prose; printed cards and the gallery API keep the old text. scripts/build-cards.mjs applies these as exact-substring replacements (in the gallery's :rb_*: icon dialect) and fails if a find-string does not match exactly once per printing.

Source for all 2026-07-23 entries: https://playriftbound.com/en-us/news/announcements/vendetta-errata-updates (fetched 2026-09-02). Riot's [C]/[1]/[M] shorthand was translated to the icon tokens the gallery uses.

entries.name: Draven, Vanquisher
entries.find: When I attack or defend, you may pay :rb_rune_fury:. If you do, give me +2 :rb_might: this turn.
entries.replace: When I attack or defend, you may pay :rb_rune_fury: to give me +2 :rb_might: this turn.

entries.name: Emperor's Dais
entries.find: you may pay :rb_energy_1: and return a unit you control here to its owner's hand. If you do, play a 2 :rb_might: Sand Soldier unit token here.
entries.replace: you may pay :rb_energy_1: and return a unit you control here to its owner's hand to play a 2 :rb_might: Sand Soldier unit token here.

entries.name: Fizz, Trickster
entries.find: Recycle that spell after you play it.

entries.name: Diana, Lunari
entries.find: you may pay :rb_energy_1:. If you do, [Predict], then reveal

entries.name: Stalking Wolf
entries.find: You may play me to its battlefield (even if you don't have other units there).
entries.replace: You may [Ambush] me to its battlefield, even if you don't have other units there.
